text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One early afternoon on a day off, I'm
strolling
through the shopping district on
the lookout for a
place to fill my
stomach, when...

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: It's all over! I'm finished!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Come on, it'll be okay—huh? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well... Lately, a bunch of new
restaurants have
opened nearby. With
the way things are going,
the owner's
worried there'll be no choice but to

close up shop.
choice_data_list: ...What in the world are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
There's no hope for a musty old place
like this.
Only trendy restaurants have a
chance of winning
over the stomachs of
today's youth.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's not true! Things are far from over!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
On my name as the proud daughter of
restaurant
owners, I'll serve as expert
consultant and
temporary face of the
restaurant until this place is
back on its
feet!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I've already got something
perfect
prepared! I call it "Operation
Umastagrammer
Attraction"!
choice_data_list: In that case, we need a plan.
In that case, we'll need a plan.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If new trends are what customers want,
let's
update the menu! You can serve up
some chic and
innovative food that'll
look great on Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
Even if we do that, it won't change
anything! It's
too little, too late! I'm just
a failure!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, we've got to do whatever we
can! All
together now! Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: Muuun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Matikanetannhauser begins
working on a
new menu tailored
specifically for social media. A
few days
later, the first customer arrives.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hello? Hellooo? ...Is this place open?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Welcome! Please come in!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser?! What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, don't you worry about that.
Why don't
you take a look at our chic
new menu instead?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Fried Firework Profusion"? "Hell-Grilled

Paradise"? "The Perfect Catch"? ...Um,
what is
this stuff?! Is it even food?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I, uh, don't really know what I'm looking
at... Can
you recommend something?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Here's your
"Off The
Rails Triple Stamina Express."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um... Is this... liver and chives?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And next we have our "Flowing Lava
Tofu
Archipelago" and "Scorching Dark
Matter
Stir-Fry."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Mapo tofu and... sweet-and-sour pork?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait! This is all just regular
Chinese
food! The only thing new about
it is the crazy
names!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oof!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sooo... Long story short, I thought up all
these
new names to try and save the
restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But, growing up with a family restaurant,
you
couldn't bring yourself to
experiment with the
dishes, so you only
made little tweaks... What a
dilemma.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I guess I really can't break away
from the
confines of being ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. No need to be so gloomy.
Let's eat all
this food you made, and
then we can come up
with a new plan.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
This is delicious! Like, unbelievably
tasty! Way
better than I expected!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's anything but ordinary! You nailed it,

Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I did?!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
Th-these flavors... They have the
potential to
revive my restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Do you mean it?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Do you mean it?!
choice_data_list: You've broken out of your "ordinary" shell!
You really broke out of your 'ordinary' shell!
All that's left is to boost your name recognition.
All that's left is to boost your name recognition.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, c'mon... All I did was try to
remember what
my family's cooking
tasted like while I made them.
choice_data_list: You've broken out of your "ordinary" shell!
You really broke out of your 'ordinary' shell!
All that's left is to boost your name recognition.
All that's left is to boost your name recognition.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Let me just face toward
home and
send a quick thank you my
parents' way.
choice_data_list: Then, be grateful to your parents.
Then, you should be thankful to your parents.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Mom and Dad. ...Oh, and you
too, little
bro. Shouldn't leave you out, I
guess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Nice Nature's social media
promotion,
an influx of new customers
saves the restaurant
from its fate.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mumun... You're right. We need a way to
get
people to try the food.

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! Why don't we use the new
face of the
restaurant to attract some
customers?! Like how
towns use mascots
to bring in tourists!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm picking up what you're putting down!
Okay,
first, I'm gonna need some wings...
And let's say I
was born in the ocean—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, you don't need any of that
stuff! And
besides, those two things
contradict each other!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the owner's eccentricity was
part of
the restaurant's original decline...
Regardless,
great reviews of the new
menu help save the
restaurant.
